answer: Score each ID on 20 public yes/no forecasts per epoch that resolve within 30 days, say whether an ocean buoy reading crosses a threshold. Resolved forecasts set like basalt into the ID's record, and payout weight follows its Brier score. Clones run by one operator share one model, so their probability vectors move together; any pair correlating above 0.95 across 60 resolved forecasts splits a single reward. Faking independence means injecting noise, which pushes accuracy over the ridge into lower pay. So each of 100 fakes must earn its own calibrated history.
